title: PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 Palawan Leg Review: RUNRIO's Island Marathon
seo_title: PalawanPay Marathon Palawan 2026 Review | Puerto Princesa Race
meta_description: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon 2026 Palawan Leg: October 18 in Puerto Princesa. Full marathon to 5K from RUNRIO — an island marathon in one of the world's best destinations.
dek: Set for 18 October 2026 in Puerto Princesa City, Palawan, this RUNRIO-produced marathon is part of the PalawanPay Trilogy. Five distances from 5K to full 42K. Registration isn't confirmed yet.
verdict: The PalawanPay Trilogy Marathon Palawan Leg combines three premium elements: RUNRIO's gold-standard race production, PalawanPay's fintech sponsorship, and Puerto Princesa — the gateway to the UNESCO-listed Underground River and one of the world's most celebrated island destinations. Five distances (42K, 21K, 16K, 10K, 5K) with the unusual 16K mid-distance option. Palawan in October is the tail of the wet season, but the destination appeal is strong enough to justify the weather risk. For runners wanting a RUNRIO-produced marathon on one of the Philippines' most beautiful islands, this is a priority track.

sections.heading: Palawan: The World's Best Island
paragraphs: Palawan consistently ranks among the world's best islands — Puerto Princesa is the gateway to the Underground River (a UNESCO World Heritage site and New 7 Wonders of Nature), Honda Bay's island-hopping, and some of the clearest water in the Philippines. [1] A RUNRIO-produced marathon here combines world-class race production with world-class post-race recovery.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: A RUNRIO-produced marathon in Palawan — one of the best destination-race combinations in the Philippines. Track for registration. 18 October 2026. [1]
